mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO MoM < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, which signals a restrictive monetary policy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS MoM > 200k and UNRATE MoM < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 YoY < 2% and INDPRO MoM < 0%.
